column1: # The throttler container starts bw-sequencer at t=0.  The test-runner starts
# iperf approximately 12 s after it detects the throttler is healthy (TC ready).
# The healthcheck passes roughly 5-10 s after bw-sequencer starts.
# Therefore iperf begins at approximately bw-sequencer t = 17-22 s.
# Timeline designed so each phase is long enough that the test runner's
# iperf measurement window falls cleanly inside it regardless of the ±10 s
#   t=0-30s   : 100 Mbps  — warmup (covers the worst-case 22 s startup delay)
#   t=30-55s  : 5 Mbps    — low-bandwidth phase  (25 s; iperf sees ≥15 s of it)
#   t=55-90s  : 100 Mbps  — high-bandwidth phase (35 s; iperf sees ≥30 s of it)
#   t=90s     : bw-sequencer tears down TC and exits
# verify.py detects the phases by sliding window rather than absolute offsets
# so it is robust to start-time variation.
